messages:
lina: quick note 1: small billing oddity from yesterday's rollout. streaming request preempted and routed; toolcall retried. customer reported a 2-token duplicate.
sam: ids?
lina: sess=sess_b12, tc=tc_77. router logs: PREEMPT -> HANDOFF -> TOOLCALL_RETRY within 80ms.
oliver: ledger created two provisional entries and both became confirmed. our dedupe key (session+prefix_hash) missed due to boundary split.
sam: short fix idea: delay auto-confirm for provisionals created within 300ms of a handoff for same session, so reconciler can check overlap. low-risk.
oliver: longer term: include prefix_range [start,end] in router events and compare ranges for overlap instead of exact hash match. runtime already tracks offsets.
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_2001 tokens=2 session=sess_b12 source=canary
billing-bot: provisional_create id=pv_2002 tokens=2 session=sess_b12 source=fallback
linA: I'll open a ticket with traces and ask support to credit the customer.
sam: I'll PR billing-bot change for 300ms and add an alert if double-confirms >0 in 24h.
